idea: Natural Gas Demand Spike From Cold Weather Pressure

data.source: Open-Meteo daily temperature data + EIA Natural Gas Spot Price from FRED (series: DHHNGSP)

behavior: When daily average temperatures drop sharply below seasonal norms across major heating regions, natural gas demand surges within 2–5 days, driving spot price volatility and energy sector strength.

market_impact.rationale: Energy sector benefits from rising input costs and demand signals; integrated oil/gas companies see margin expansion.

trade_logic.entry: If 7-day rolling average temperature drops >8°F below 30-year seasonal baseline AND EIA spot price rises >3% in 2 days
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days OR when temperature recovers within 3°F of baseline

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Winter/shoulder seasons produce temperature swings >8°F almost weekly in Northern Hemisphere; energy prices react predictably within 2–5 days.

idea: Freight Rate Compression Signal From Weekly Load Matching Data

data.source: Cass Freight Index Weekly Spot Trucking Rate Index (public HTML tables from cass.com or via FRED TRUCKD series proxy)

behavior: When spot trucking rates fall >5% weekly and load-to-truck ratio dips below 0.85, freight pricing weakness signals logistics cost relief for manufacturers and retailers.

market_impact.rationale: Industrial and manufacturing sectors see margin expansion from lower freight input costs; transportation suppliers face headwinds but overall manufacturing profit improves.

trade_logic.entry: Cass Trucking Rate Index drops >5% week-over-week AND 4-week moving average of rate falls below prior 12-week mean
trade_logic.exit: After 15 trading days OR rates rise back above 12-week mean

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Spot trucking rates fluctuate >5% almost every 2–3 weeks; mean reversion trades fire frequently in logistics data.

idea: Labor Market Weakness Signal From Weekly Jobless Claims Momentum Fade

data.source: FRED Initial Jobless Claims (ICSA) weekly series

behavior: When 4-week moving average of jobless claims rises >8% from prior month's mean, labor demand is weakening; this precedes consumer spending weakness by 1–3 weeks.

market_impact.rationale: Consumer discretionary sector faces headwinds from rising unemployment; advertising and retail demand fade as hiring slows.

trade_logic.entry: 4-week MA of jobless claims rises >8% from 12-week baseline AND 2-week acceleration is >3%
trade_logic.exit: After 15 trading days OR jobless claims fall back below 105% of 12-week baseline

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Jobless claims oscillate >8% on a 4-week basis 4–6 times per year; summer and winter layoff cycles are predictable.

idea: EV Charger Buildout Pace Acceleration From OpenChargeMap Growth

data.source: OpenChargeMap public API charger count by region, weekly snapshots

behavior: When weekly net charger additions exceed 3-month rolling average by >20% (indicating infrastructure investment surge), EV adoption momentum signals bullish tech/industrial transition thesis.

market_impact.rationale: Accelerating charger deployment signals adoption of EV tech platforms, battery management systems, and digital infrastructure; semiconductor and software demand benefits.

trade_logic.entry: Weekly charger additions >120% of 12-week rolling average AND 2-week cumulative additions >250 units
trade_logic.exit: After 20 trading days OR weekly additions fall back to 90% of rolling average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Infrastructure grants and regional EV mandates create periodic surges in charger deployment; spikes above rolling average occur 6–8 times per year.

idea: Google Trends Surge In 'Pest Control Service' Searches Signals Consumer Stress & Healthcare Sector Demand

data.source: Google Trends weekly search interest for keyword 'pest control service near me'

behavior: Spikes in pest control search interest indicate reactive household maintenance spending during stress periods or seasonal pest surges; correlates with consumer financial pressure and home repair urgency.

market_impact.rationale: Rising pest control searches indicate unplanned household spending and deferred discretionary purchases; signals consumer budget pressure reducing retail/dining spending.

trade_logic.entry: Weekly Google Trends index for 'pest control service' rises >35% from 8-week rolling average
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days OR index falls back below 115% of 8-week average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal pest waves and weather-driven infestations trigger search spikes spring/summer; summer 2025 will see multiple >35% spikes.

idea: Wheat & Corn Price Volatility Spike From USDA Crop Condition Weekly Reports

data.source: FRED Wheat Prices (PWHEAMTUSD) + Corn Prices (PMAIZMTUSD) daily, cross-referenced with USDA weekly crop progress reports (HTML scrape)

behavior: When USDA crop condition ratings drop >5% week-over-week (indicating drought/pest pressure) or exceed -10% from prior year, commodity prices spike within 2–4 days and agricultural input inflation signals ripple through food supply chains.

market_impact.rationale: Consumer staples (food producers) face margin compression from rising agricultural input costs; pricing power is limited.

trade_logic.entry: USDA crop condition rating falls >5 points week-over-week AND corn/wheat futures close >2% higher on news day
trade_logic.exit: After 12 trading days OR crop conditions stabilize (improve >3 points) for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Growing season (May–August) produces crop condition volatility nearly every week; 2–3 rating drops >5 points expected each summer.

idea: Airline Load Factor Weakness From BTS Data Signals Travel Demand Fade

data.source: BTS Airline Load Factor (% seats filled) weekly, via BTS public data portal or FRED proxy

behavior: When airline load factors decline >3 percentage points week-over-week (e.g., 82% → 79%), demand for leisure/business travel is softening; airlines cut capacity and fares within 1–2 weeks, signaling consumer discretionary stress.

market_impact.rationale: Collapsing airline load factors are leading indicator of consumer travel spending pullback; signals weakness in hotels, car rentals, restaurants.

trade_logic.entry: Airline load factor drops >3 percentage points week-over-week AND 2-week rolling average falls below 78%
trade_logic.exit: After 12 trading days OR load factor recovers >2 points above entry level

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal demand swings post-holiday and pre-summer produce >3 point drops monthly; recession/economic shock scenarios fire this signal weekly.

idea: Earthquake Swarm Activity Spike Signals Infrastructure & Insurance Sector Volatility

data.source: USGS Earthquake API daily magnitude >3.0 event counts from seismic networks

behavior: When earthquake swarm activity (5+ magnitude >3.0 events within 7 days in a single region) occurs, insurance claim expectations rise and infrastructure repair demand spikes; regional economic disruption signals follow within 1–3 days.

market_impact.rationale: Infrastructure repair, engineering services, and heavy equipment demand increase; construction sector benefits from disaster-driven capital deployment.

trade_logic.entry: 7-day rolling count of magnitude >3.0 earthquakes in any USGS region exceeds 5 events AND closest prior 30-day window had <4 events
trade_logic.exit: After 20 trading days OR seismic activity returns to <2 events per 7-day window

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Known seismic zones (California, Pacific Northwest, Taiwan) experience swarm activity 3–4 times per quarter; aftershock sequences trigger this signal regularly.

idea: Political Insider Filing Concentration On Healthcare Sector Signals Regulatory Shift

data.source: SEC Form 4 insider trading filings (daily scrape) filtered by healthcare sector filers; cross-reference with House/Senate committee membership

behavior: When healthcare sector insider filings surge >300% on 5-day rolling basis and majority are net SELLS (not buys), congressional committee activity on drug pricing or reimbursement is often imminent; sector volatility follows within 5–10 days.

market_impact.rationale: Insider selling in healthcare sector signals anticipation of adverse regulatory action or margin pressure from pricing reform proposals.

trade_logic.entry: 5-day rolling healthcare sector Form 4 count >3x prior 30-day daily average AND net sell % >60%
trade_logic.exit: After 15 trading days OR healthcare insider buying returns to >40% of filings

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Congress healthcare committee hearings/votes occur 2–3 times per month; insider selling spikes precede legislative announcements by 3–7 days.

idea: RSS News Count Spike On Semiconductor Supply Chain Disruptions Signals XLK Volatility

data.source: RSS feed aggregation (Feedly/RSS Monkey) counting daily mentions of 'semiconductor supply chain disruption' or 'chip fab outage'

behavior: When daily RSS news count on semiconductor supply chain issues rises >150% from 20-day baseline, market is pricing in equipment delays and fab utilization risk; tech sector reprices within 1–3 days.

market_impact.rationale: Supply chain disruption headlines force semiconductor equipment makers and fabless designers to revise guidance; sentiment turns bearish immediately.

trade_logic.entry: Daily RSS count >150% of 20-day rolling average AND closes above prior day count
trade_logic.exit: After 8 trading days OR RSS count falls back below 120% of rolling average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Fab maintenance windows, geopolitical tensions, and trade policy changes trigger supply chain news spikes 2–3 times per month; sentiment shifts are immediate and measurable.
